thread:
Ethan (Partnerships): Quick brainstorm: we need a clearer partner SEV path that covers cloud marketplace listings, hardware partner firmware faults, and SI-managed installs. Current gaps: partners without button access, SI installs that rely on email-only oncall, and joint announcement coordination. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

Nora (HW Partner Eng): +1. For HW partners we often need an immediate phone escalation (hardware island) because Slack can be flaky at colo sites. We should define a 3-path model: 1) Shared channel buttons (preferred), 2) Slash-command or reaction fallback, 3) Pager/phone for fully offline cases.

Sofia (SI Program): For SIs, many of our integrators restrict external Slack. They want a documented email subject format + an automated bridge creation link in the reply. A predictable subject line helps automated routing. Eg: SUBJECT: [PSEV][Partner:Voltix][Cust:AcmeCorp] short impact.

Diego (Support Escalations): Agree. Also propose a small escalation matrix in the channel pinned message: when severity=sev1 -> page SRE + partner-oncall + SI-liaison; sev2 -> page support lead + partner-liaison. Keep sev3 as async.

Mika (SRE): Implementation note: if we page oncall from the channel, include these metadata tags in the payload so runbooks can auto-load: marketplace_listing_id, partner_region, hw_serial (if applicable), si_ticket_id. That reduces context switching.

Ethan (Partnerships): Good call. How do we handle joint announcements? Need a fast way to mark an incident as "partner-visible" so marketing & legal can join the canal. Maybe add a channel topic tag and a minimal checklist link.

Sofia (SI Program): We should add a single checkbox flow: "Partner Visible?" button when creating the war room that DM's marketing and legal with the joint announcement playbook. No one wants ten extra messages.

Nora (HW Partner Eng): For phone escalations we should keep a short verification step: confirm hardware serial and site. Prevent accidental pagers. A two-step confirm when using phone path.

Diego (Support Escalations): Fallbacks: if partner can't use buttons, accept one of the following as equivalent to a button hit: 1) email to partner-sev@redwood.example with correct subject format, 2) reaction :red_circle: on the pinned triage message, 3) `/partner-sev` slash command. All should create the same audit event.

Mika (SRE): And we need runbook linking: include a short link in every created bridge to the correct runbook variant (marketplace/hw/si). The bridge creation API can accept runbook_id.

Ethan (Partnerships): Draft pin message for shared channels (suggested):

Ethan (Partnerships): """
Partner SEV quick guide:
- Use buttons to start a War Room (preferred)
- If Slack is restricted: send email to partner-sev@redwood.example with SUBJECT: [PSEV][Partner:<partner>][Cust:<customer>] short summary
- For hardware-site outages with no network: call the partner phone oncall at +1-555-7700 (confirm serial before paging)
- Severity routing:
  - SEV1: page SRE, Support Escalations, Partner Oncall, SI Liaison
  - SEV2: page Support Lead, Partner Liaison
  - SEV3: async triage in channel
- If incident is partner-visible, click "Mark Partner Visible" to notify Marketing + Legal and lock joint-announcement staging
"""

Sofia (SI Program): Looks good. Add an explicit line about consent for sharing customer logs with partner and a short link to the data sharing policy.

Nora (HW Partner Eng): Also add: "If firmware panic is suspected, attach hw_serial and fw_version in the initial triage". Saves us time.

Diego (Support Escalations): Action items: 1) Ethan to write the pinned message + subject-format templates (owner: Ethan). 2) Mika to add payload fields to bridge creation API + ensure runbook_id can be passed (owner: Mika). 3) Nora to provide phone oncall numbers and phone confirm flow (owner: Nora). 4) Sofia to draft email subject enforcement for SI partners and the data-sharing blurb (owner: Sofia). 5) Diego to update the escalation matrix doc and create shortcuts for paging rules (owner: Diego).

Ethan (Partnerships): I'll publish the pinned guide in partners channels and create a short partner-facing one-pager. Scheduling a 30-min run-through with HW + SI reps next Tue.

ops-bot: Reminder created: "Partner SEV pathway run-through" 2025-01-14 09:00 PST. Invitees: @partners-team, @hw-liaisons, @si-program. Calendar link: https://meet.redwood.example/run-456

Mika (SRE): One more: audit events must include who initiated the action (partner vs internal) and a correlation id so downstream telemetry links to the bridge. Can't stress that enough.

Diego (Support Escalations): Agreed. We'll also log the chosen escalation path (button/email/phone) in the incident record.

Ethan (Partnerships): Thanks all. If there are no objections I'll finalize the pinned message and open a tiny RFC for the button payload fields later today. :thumbsup:
